name: click-to-source-3d
description: Source-level debugging for Three.js & React Three Fiber. Click any rendered object to trace it back to the source code that generated it.

scripts.//build: Dependency order, spelled out. `npm run build --workspaces` runs them alphabetically, which puts examples second and vite-plugin last — and the example's vite.config imports the plugin from its dist, so on a clean clone that ordering fails before the plugin exists.
